about:
Q&D Wire Cable Assembly Inc. operates in Hillsboro, Oregon, in the Silicon Forest region just west of Portland. The company traces its plastic molding expertise to a spin-off from Tektronix more than 50 years ago, originally located in Forest Grove before moving to its current Hillsboro facility in 2011. The cable assembly and contract assembly divisions have been serving local manufacturers since 2008.

The shop provides custom wire and cable assemblies, electrical and mechanical box builds, injection/compression/transfer plastic molding, and ECN rework and fulfillment services. It specializes in high-mix, low-to-medium volume production, handling wire sizes from 14 to 32 AWG, coaxial and ribbon cables, and a range of thermoplastic and thermoset materials. Processes include hand and semi-automatic crimping, lead-free soldering, epoxy potting, 100% electrical testing, and hipot testing with reports. Molding capacity runs up to 12-ounce parts on presses up to 150 tons.

Customers span aviation, industrial, consumer, medical, robotics, aerospace, military, sensor, and UAV/UAS sectors. The company works with electronic component distributors such as TTI and Heilind, and with OEMs including LightSpeed Technologies, Forest Dental, Engle Dental Systems, and Warn Industries.

Q&D emphasizes a quality-first culture backed by AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 certification and IPC/WHMA-A-620 workmanship compliance. Its differentiators include lean manufacturing expertise, quick-turn flexibility, engineering and design-for-manufacturability support, and a supply chain stocked with major connector brands. The rework and fulfillment offering addresses engineering-change orders and non-conforming product already in the supply chain.

name: QB Studios-a julsdesign company
old_description: We’re faster, friendlier, and more fun than your average branding agency.
about:
QB Studios operates from Ankeny, Iowa, formed through the merger of julsdesign, inc. and QB Studios Custom Apparel. The combined entity brings together creative branding and custom apparel decoration under one roof.

The company provides three core services: creative design (logos, brand refreshes, publications, trade-show graphics), premium custom apparel decoration on tees, hoodies, hats, and jackets using direct-to-film, vinyl, printing, and embroidery, and promotional product sourcing and branding for items such as drinkware and desk toys. All production is handled in-house, and the firm also runs an outlet store for overstock and closeout items.

Clients range from marketing departments and small businesses to associations and event organizers. Testimonials cite work for Happy DSM (branded aprons, hats, T-shirts), JC Toland (multi-company marketing support), Uptown Ankeny (local business branding), and the SBAIA (event signage and promotional items).

QB Studios positions itself as a faster, friendlier alternative to traditional agencies, emphasizing “everything under one roof,” 30-plus years of combined experience, and a team that acts as an extension of the client’s staff without the overhead.

name: QSR Steel Corporation
old_description: QSR Steel is an exceptional one-stop, full service structural steel company based in Hartford, CT offering everything from steel buildings to stairs and railings.
about:
QSR Steel Corporation was founded in 2000 in Hartford, Connecticut, as a structural steel and miscellaneous metals fabricator. The company began with a focus on miscellaneous metals before expanding into structural steel in response to customer demand.

The firm operates two AISC‑certified fabrication facilities where it produces structural steel and miscellaneous metal components such as architectural canopies, mezzanines, bollards, ladders, stairs, and railings. In‑house detailing teams use Building Information Modeling (BIM) and CNC‑driven machinery to translate 3D models directly to the shop floor, and the company maintains its own erection crews to handle installation without third‑party subcontractors.

QSR serves construction, renovation, commercial, industrial, retail, education, and municipal clients across New England. Recent projects include the ShopRite supermarket in Cromwell (retail), the Cheney Bennett Pedestrian Bridge in Manchester (commercial/industrial), the William Johnston School (education), and work for the Town of Darien (municipal).

The company emphasizes that controlling both fabrication and erection eliminates coordination delays and quality‑control issues. Its mission cites sustainable procedures certified by AISC, and its track record includes multiple safety awards from the Connecticut Association of Builders and Contractors and recognition as a Top 5000 fastest‑growing company (2008‑2010).

Quality Electrical Systems operates from West Jordan, Utah, where it has built a 350,000-square-foot manufacturing facility alongside a 75,000-square-foot inventory warehouse. The company has been in business for three decades, though a specific founding year is not disclosed, and ownership details such as family or veteran status are not publicly stated.

The firm produces custom electrical equipment including switchgear, power distribution centers (PDCs), and variable frequency drives (VFDs). Its OEM manufacturing contracts serve major international brands such as GE/ABB, Yaskawa, Danfoss, and TMEIC. Products ship globally from the Utah campus.

Primary end markets include data centers, oil and gas, water and wastewater treatment, and mining. The company emphasizes design evolution to meet changing industry specifications and customer requirements.

QES cites its rapid expansion and design approach as differentiators, aiming to deliver quality and innovation through continuous design improvement.

about:
Qorvo Inc. is a wireless semiconductor company headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, founded in 2015. The company's website notes a combination with Skyworks, though the founding owners or individuals are not disclosed in public materials.

Qorvo designs and manufactures radio frequency (RF) solutions, wireless chipsets, and switches. It operates GaN and GaAs foundry services, advanced packaging, die preparation, and space screening through its U.S. manufacturing facilities. The company employs between 5,000 and 9,999 people, though facility square footage and annual production volumes are not published.

The company serves automotive, consumer, defense and aerospace, industrial and enterprise, infrastructure, and mobile markets. Its customer base includes Lockheed Martin for defense applications, Pozyx for dairy farm productivity tracking, and Budweiser Budvar for logistics solutions, according to published success stories.

Qorvo emphasizes an integrated flow from RF design to qualified hardware, combining process, packaging, and test to reduce iteration cycles. The company states it prioritizes employee well‑being, environmental sustainability, and supply chain excellence as part of its mission to connect, protect, and power the planet.

name: Quabbin Wire & Cable Co Inc
about:
Quabbin Wire & Cable Co Inc operates from Ware, Massachusetts, where it runs two dedicated manufacturing facilities. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it has established itself as a specialist in communication cable design and production.

The company focuses on stranded data cable, harsh‑environment Ethernet, power and control, and multiconductor electronic constructions. One plant is configured exclusively for Ethernet cable production, while the other handles general‑purpose wire and cable. This separation allows operators to optimize each line for efficiency and consistency. Quabbin also offers patch‑cable solutions under its DataMax® brand, including CMP‑rated plenum cables rated to 105 °C, and provides engineering support, cable‑finder tools, and inventory lookup services.

Quabbin’s product lines serve industrial automation, commercial data‑communications, audiovisual and lighting control, and general‑purpose electrical markets. Customers range from OEMs needing harsh‑environment data cables for factory floors to contractors specifying plenum‑rated patch cords for building infrastructure. The company’s sales support representatives assist with connector selection and UL certification questions.

Quabbin differentiates itself by holding tighter tolerances than standard requirements and by conducting rigorous testing that exceeds industry norms. It promotes a “USA Made” commitment, 100 % on‑time delivery, competitive pricing, and direct access to cable‑design specialists. The company has been featured on the Discovery Channel, highlighting its manufacturing capabilities.

name: Quad 4 Plastics

about:
Quad 4 Plastics operates from Elkhart, Indiana, where it runs two production plants and a distribution warehouse. The company describes itself as a "powerful partner for over 20 years," though a specific founding year is not published. Ownership structure and founders are not disclosed.

The firm provides custom plastic injection molding, thermoforming, and vacuum forming, including insert molding and precision trimming of thermoformed parts. It supports projects from initial sketches through CAD/CAM design, tooling fabrication, and finishing, and adds assembly, packaging, and nationwide distribution from its Elkhart warehouse. The operation specializes in medium- to heavy-gauge thermoplastic parts and emphasizes quick turnarounds.

Quad 4 serves customers in construction furniture, LPG and NH3 equipment, electronics, marine, recreational vehicle, automotive, and general furniture sectors. Its components range from small, complex aesthetic parts to large structural pieces.

The company positions itself on end-to-end capability—design, molding, finishing, and logistics under one roof—to safeguard product integrity and lower production costs. It highlights continuous improvement, adoption of new technology, and ethical business practices as core to its approach.

name: Quality Cable Contractors, Inc.
old_description: QCCI specializes in commercial low-voltage projects including offices, hospitality, multifamily, aviation, and municipal facilities. Contact us to discuss your specific project requirements.
about:
Quality Cable Contractors, Inc. (QCCI) is an Orlando, Florida-based low-voltage systems contractor licensed and insured in the state. The company serves Central Florida with design, installation, testing, and support for structured cabling, fiber optics, wireless access, security, surveillance, CATV, CCTV, and business communication systems.

QCCI delivers end-to-end low-voltage infrastructure services including structured cabling, fiber optic backbone and distribution, security and surveillance systems, business phone systems, intercom systems, and network infrastructure. The firm follows a four-step process—assess, design, install, and support—to engineer solutions for reliability, performance, and future growth. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

The contractor works across commercial offices, education, aviation, hospitality, multifamily, and municipal/public facilities. Named clients include the Greater Orlando Aviation Authority (voice/data/CATV, wireless access points, IP cameras, fiber installation and OTDR testing) and Orange County Public Schools (voice/data/CATV, paging, fiber terminations). Rosen Hotels & Resorts is also listed as a organization.

QCCI emphasizes being "Built on Experience. Driven by Innovation." and cites licensed and insured status, industry-certified technicians, on-time/on-budget delivery, cutting-edge technology, safety and code compliance, and proven field experience as differentiators. The company states a customer-first focus with a commitment to 100% customer satisfaction.

name: Quality Manufacturing Services Inc
old_description: QMS is a full-service Electronics Manufacturing Services provider, located in Central Florida’s technology hub. Founded in 1995 and emerging as the region’s premier
about:
Quality Manufacturing Services Inc. (QMS) operates from a 52,000-square-foot facility in Lake Mary, Florida, within Central Florida's technology corridor. The company was founded in 1995 and transitioned to an employee-owned ESOP structure, aligning every worker's stake with the business's long-term performance.

QMS delivers full-service electronics manufacturing, spanning PCB assembly, rapid prototyping, engineering support (DFM, DFQ, DFT), program management, testing (including flying-probe and X-ray), conformal coating, and repair depot services. The shop runs automated SMT lines capable of 01005 placement, nitrogen-purge reflow, and a PVA conformal coating system, supported by statistical process control across ten data collection centers.

The customer base spans industrial, military, medical, networking, entertainment, transportation, unmanned aerial systems, traffic management, and life-safety sectors. References include defense contractors, building security system manufacturers, and electrical test equipment makers who rely on QMS for both through-hole and surface-mount assemblies built to J-STD-001 and inspected to IPC-A-610.

Leadership emphasizes that the ESOP culture drives continuous improvement and personal accountability, while the AS9100-certified quality system and a dedicated Fast Track program compress lead times without sacrificing compliance. The company states its founding principle was to exceed customer expectations through technical excellence, superior service, and unrelenting tenacity.
